title: Sarajevo grows over 575 years
episode: The Evolution of Sarajevo, 1451 to 2026: 3D History Timelapse
description: A 3D animated map of Sarajevo growing from an Ottoman market town, founded in the 1400s around the bazaar of Baščaršija, through Austro-Hungarian rule and Yugoslavia to today.

title: A shot that changed the world
episode: A Shot that Changed the World - The Assassination of Franz Ferdinand I PRELUDE TO WW1 - Part 3/3
description: How a group of young conspirators lined the riverside road on June 28, 1914, how the first attempt failed, and how a wrong turn later that morning brought the archduke’s car to Gavrilo Princip, by the Latin Bridge.

title: The city and the siege
episode: Sarajevo: The City and the Siege
description: A documentary on Sarajevo’s history and the siege of 1992 to 1996. In August 1992 shelling burned the city hall, then the National Library, with most of its books. It was rebuilt and reopened in 2014.

title: The hotel on Sniper Alley
episode: 🇧🇦 Holiday Inn Sarajevo: In the Eye of the Siege | War Hotels
description: The yellow Holiday Inn, built for the 1984 Olympics, housed the foreign press during the siege. It stood on the main avenue, called Sniper Alley because snipers in the hills fired on anyone crossing it.

title: The tunnel
episode: Bosnia: The Secret Tunnel That Saved Sarajevo
description: A short visit to the tunnel dug under the airport runway in 1993, the only way in or out of the besieged city. Food, weapons, and people went through it. A short stretch is preserved under a family’s house.

title: The Haggadah
show: Centropa Cinema: digital story telling and 20th century Jewish memory
episode: Searching For Hope: The Sarajevo Haggadah
place: National Museum of Bosnia and Herzegovina
description: A film on the Sarajevo Haggadah and the people who protected it: Derviš Korkut, the Muslim librarian who hid it from the Nazis in 1942, and the museum staff who saved it during the siege.

title: Olympic ruins
episode: The Tragedy of Sarajevo's Abandoned Winter Olympic Ruins
description: Sarajevo hosted the Winter Olympics in 1984. Eight years later the bobsleigh track on Mount Trebević became a front-line position. It is now abandoned and covered in graffiti, and the cable car runs up to it again.

title: Torvill and Dean’s Boléro
episode: Jayne Torvill and Christopher Dean's Legendary Bolero Performance | Music Monday
description: The British ice dancers Jayne Torvill and Christopher Dean skating to Ravel’s Boléro at the 1984 Olympics, in the Zetra hall. All nine judges gave them perfect marks for artistic impression.

title: Sevdalinka
description: UNESCO’s film on sevdalinka, Bosnia’s slow, sad urban love songs, which it added to its list of intangible heritage in 2024. The House of Sevdah, in an old Ottoman house, is a small museum of the music.

title: Ćevapi
episode: How different types of Cevapcici are made in the Balkans
description: How ćevapi, small grilled sausages of minced meat, differ across the Balkans. In Sarajevo they come ten to a portion, inside a soft flatbread called somun, with raw onion. Baščaršija is full of ćevabdžinicas, the shops that serve them.
